Several diﬀ erent classes of medications can
assist in treating inﬂ ammation. Nonsteroidal anti-
inﬂ ammatory medications (NSAIDs), selective 
COX-2 inhibitors, and glucocorticoids are all used 
to treat inﬂ ammation.8 All of these medications 
block this process in one or more steps. Salicylates 
(aspirin), an NSAID, inhibit prostaglandin produc-
tion. Other nonsteroidal anti-inﬂ ammatory medi-
cations, such as ibuprofen, further prevent synthe-
sis of prostaglandins by blocking cyclooxygenase 
enzyme 2 (COX-2; see Figure 9.11). Unfortunately,
